disk.why_they_are_counted: the handlers that make these run on a cadence, and until 2026-09-25 they used `tempfile.mkdtemp`, which never removes what it creates. They now scope the directory to the work, so a number that keeps climbing here is either work in flight or a new call site that forgot. Counted rather than cleaned: deleting a directory another process is writing into loses that job's work
